title: Genetics I
modules: Principles Of Segregation (Mendel'S First Law Of
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible e.g. for high production of milk in cattle, size and shape of the penis in males, breast development in women, heavy beard development in men and testicular feminisation."

Sex-limited traits or genes are responsible e.g. for high production of milk in cattle, size and shape of the penis in males, breast development in women, heavy beard development in men and testicular feminisation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a long twining chain of genetic materials."
The chromosome is a long twining chain of genetic materials.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the need to ensure that the same letter is used for alleles since that is the only way of making it unambiguous that the phenotypes belong to the same gene."
Equally important is the need to ensure that the same letter is used for alleles since that is the only way of making it unambiguous that the phenotypes belong to the same gene.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the two x-chromosomes in the female."
The Barr body is one of the two x-chromosomes in the female.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to variations in the numbers of individual chromosomes."
Aneuploidy on the other hand refers to variations in the numbers of individual chromosomes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the general characteristics of all living organisms."
Reproduction is one of the general characteristics of all living organisms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described as "webbing" of the neck because the folds are similar to those between the toes of a duck."
The condition is described as "webbing" of the neck because the folds are similar to those between the toes of a duck.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an offspring from two different parental types."
A hybrid is an offspring from two different parental types.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the mechanism of genetic control of traits showing continuous variation."
Quantitative inheritance is the mechanism of genetic control of traits showing continuous variation.
